contract: Compilation records and retained metadata preserve their existing ordinary Vector formats. Codegen decodes saved records and checks source digests without parser fallback. The unchanged authored SourceRegistry owns name publication, duplicate rejection and replacement. Publication forwards the caller continuation through current Id sends; no native source table or Id contract is added.
negative_checks: Inspection neither publishes nor attaches metadata to the input String.
Equal text with a different identity does not acquire the registered record.
Saved records and recorded method sources work with Lang parse: disabled; raw-source preparation still calls it.
Digest mismatch, conflicting duplicate and wrong-name publication leave the registry revision unchanged.
Replacing SourceRegistry during a suspended publication does not redirect or replay the entered call.
lifetime: A retained revision snapshot preserves its old source/metadata after replacement and GC. Prepared records survive suspension with the original registry implementation while future calls observe rebinding.
scope: Source metadata inspection, retained records, authored source registration and documentation inventory. Filename-aware evaluation, source/file loading, artifact admission, recovery, complete bootstrap/Host, images/workers and installed qualification remain pending. Unconnected evaluation/Generation algorithms are retained in pending_source.rs.
